question: Disrespecting of National Flag is a violation of which of the following Fundamental Duties mentioned in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51A(a)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Disrespecting of National Flag** is a violation of **Article 51A(a)** of the Indian Constitution.
